Name: Two For Joy - NPC Miriam
Author: handwrittenhello
Description:
Meet a brand new farmer, Miriam, who lives west of the railroad and north of the backwoods. Forge a bond with her as you uncover the reasons behind her hostile demeanor and show her that there's still joy to be found in the world. Fully compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and other major expansions! 

Content warning: Miriam's story revolves around grief. For detailed warnings click the spoiler below:
[spoiler]Miriam moves to the valley after the death of her adult child. Through interactions with the farmer, negative or positive, she and the farmer slowly learn to move on while still remembering lost loved ones.[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Vck5M8ND/features.png[/img][list]
[*]Six heart events
[*]Two new maps
[*]One new crop
[*]Over two hundred lines of dialogue
[/list][u]
